name: Less Grind Hits - fewer swings, faster tree fall
author: Anders
description: Fewer swings for pickaxe, axe and scythe. Pickaxe: nothing above 6 swings, plain stone in 1, better pickaxes help in proportion to tier. Axe: nothing above 4. Scythe: nothing above 2. For axe and scythe every tier above the minimum halves the swings. Minimum tool tiers are unchanged. Felled trees fall in about 0.4 seconds instead of 2.2, so you can move again sooner. Also makes the game use the best axe you carry. Edit the CONFIG block in js/plugins/LessGrindHits.js.
